llm.summary: This skill does what it advertises: it queries train tickets, station transport, and hotels using external travel, map, and 12306 services.

dimensions.detail: The capabilities are coherent with the stated travel purpose: train search, 12306 remaining-ticket lookup, station transport routing, and hotel recommendation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The tools are user-directed and scoped to supplied travel inputs, but the documentation names external data flow only generally and does not identify the Tencent SCF proxy endpoints or warn that hotel free text is forwarded.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only SKILL.md and one Python script; no install hooks, package installation, or automatic setup behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network calls to travel, map, AI-search, and 12306 endpoints are proportionate for the feature set; no broad local file, credential, or profile access was found.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No filesystem writes, background workers, privilege escalation, subprocess execution, or durable persistence were found; the only cache is an in-memory station-code map.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Reasonable to install if you are comfortable sharing travel routes, addresses, dates, and hotel preferences with external travel/map/AI services. Avoid putting highly sensitive personal details into hotel requests, and verify booking links and prices before purchasing.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The proxy calls send route, address, station, city, and date parameters to external services; this is expected for ticket and routing lookup, though exact proxy operators are under-described.
[SQP-2] expected: The 12306 station metadata and remaining-ticket requests are directly tied to the advertised 12306 ticket feature and are disclosed in the skill text.
[SSD-3] expected: Forwarding the hotel query to an external AI search service is consistent with AI hotel recommendations, but users should avoid including sensitive personal details in free-form lodging requests.
